title: PejorativITy: Disambiguating Pejorative Epithets to Improve Misogyny Detection in Italian Tweets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating BERT-based classifiers on misogyny detection datasets using concatenation and substitution of disambiguated pejorative epithets, analyzing the cosine similarity of contextualized word embeddings between polysemic terms and offensive/neutral anchors, and zero-shot prompting of generative LLMs to define gender-targeted pejorative words in context.
